- `hebrew_rtl_fixture.pdf` — **Phase 101 D-06.** 1-2 page excerpt from the Phase 100 UAT
  Hebrew/Judeo-Arabic book that surfaced the RTL word-order bug. Provided by Hillel Gershuni for the
  RTL extraction regression test (`test_sort_true_rtl_real_hebrew_fixture`). Used for non-commercial
  research testing only; copyright remains with the original publisher/author. The real-fixture test
  skips silently when this file is absent so downstream forks/CI without the asset stay green.

## Phase 102 fixtures

Generated by `tests/scripts/build_phase102_fixtures.py` (run to regenerate after a PyMuPDF upgrade).
All three PDFs use provenance-scripted construction (Codex LOW-11) so the binary content is reproducible.

- `letter_spaced_hebrew.pdf` — **Phase 102 F-D/F-E/F-F/D-06.** Hebrew text laid out with correct
  RTL physical glyph ordering (first logical letter at highest x, matching real Hebrew PDF layout).
  Each word is a single `insert_text` call with the reversed NFC string so `_order_unit_text_rtl`
  recovers the correct logical Unicode order. Exercises:
    - **F-D:** single-letter-token ratio after full pipeline = 0.0 (< 0.15 threshold).
    - **F-E:** "מלחמת" appears in extracted text after RTL reorder.
    - **F-F:** "תיכון" emitted first (lower x) and "אבן" second (higher x) — WRONG emission order;
      reorder reconstructs correct reading order "אבן תיכון".
    - **D-06 FINAL:** vocalized "שָׁלוֹם" with nikud; strip_nikud → "שלום"; un-vocalized search matches.

- `ltr_latin_noregress.pdf` — **Phase 102 D-03 LTR no-regression pin.** Clean Latin text with the
  phrase "Northwest Semitic Dictionary". The Phase 102 rawdict pipeline must preserve this phrase
  un-scrambled and maintain token count within the D-03 guard band (>= 95% of old blocks output).

- `corrupt_encoding_sample.pdf` — **Phase 102 F-G / D-F16.** Content stream patched with 300 C1
  control characters (0x81-0x9F via `doc.update_stream`); Helvetica has no ToUnicode entry for
  these codes so PyMuPDF extracts them verbatim as garbage. `_detect_corrupt_encoding()` returns
  True (garbage_ratio > 5%), and `_extract_and_write_pdf` returns status='corrupt_encoding' with
  pages_written=0 (HIGH-2 detect-before-write).
